annotation.authors_or_issuer: Palmier, C.; Rigaud, A.-S.; Ogawa, T.; Wieching, R.; Dacunha, S.; Barbarossa, F. et al.
annotation.summary_en: Narrative review of 25 publications on ethical issues of robotic coaching solutions for older adults, analysed with the EUnetHTA Core Model. It identifies concerns (accidents, reliability, deception, isolation, data confidentiality, liability) and recommends user consultation, consent, professional training, data protection, and a scalable ethical and regulatory framework.
annotation.title_clean: Identification of Ethical Issues and Practice Recommendations Regarding the Use of Robotic Coaching Solutions for Older Adults: Narrative Review
annotation.title_en: Identification of Ethical Issues and Practice Recommendations Regarding the Use of Robotic Coaching Solutions for Older Adults: Narrative Review
key_provisions_or_claims: Most cited concerns: accident risk, unreliability, loss of control, deception, social isolation, data confidentiality, liability
Recommends collecting target users' opinions and informed consent
Recommends training professionals in RCS use
Proper data management, anonymization and encryption are essential
Suggests a scalable ethical and regulatory framework for RCS development and implementation
